description: API health and security audit of one public http(s) endpoint: 3-10 sample requests for uptime, status codes and latency (p50/p95), TLS certificate and expiry, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, frame options), CORS policy, rate-limit headers, caching, compression and response validity, with a score and prioritized fixes. Only the given URL is probed; optional probe headers are never stored. $9 USDC on Base via x402; invalid input and failed runs are not charged. Most x402 clients cap one payment at $0.10 by default; raise the cap for this tool. Price: $9 per run. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

body.description: Optional POST probe body (string or JSON, max 16 KB)

headers.description: Optional probe headers (never stored or echoed)

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key: same payer + requestKey + input returns the stored result without a second charge (7 days).

url.description: Public http(s) API endpoint to audit

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.

name: api_health_audit
title: API endpoint health + security audit
